column1: # Networks tracked as first-class groups by scraper/networks.py.
# One row per network. networks.py resolves each network's shows to their RSS
#   data/networks.json      (per-network roster + host breakdown; the site reads this)
#   label       display name of the network
#               show the channel page lists is discovered automatically.
#   extra_ids   ;-separated Apple SHOW ids always included (back catalog
#   search      iTunes name-search term (artistTerm); keeps only shows whose
#               author credits the network. Used for networks with no Apple
#               channel. If channel_id/extra_ids/search are all blank
#               is used as the search term.
# Feed URLs + hosts are filled in by networks.py
